event_name: Document 72 Date 04 July 2021 Time 20:04 2021 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 July 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 63) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine
fact: Alleged not respecting double waved yellow flags in turn 5.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix H Article 2.5.5. b) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 10 (Pierre Gasly), team representative and reviewed video and telemetry evidence. The Stewards accepted that the driver took the appropriate action in the double waved yellow sectors.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 10 Alleged Not Respecting Double Waved Yellow Flags
